run_SAM3DBody_inference: run full-body 3D pose inference with body and hand decoders on an input image batch
run_SAM3DBody_forward_step: run a single forward step through the body or hand decoder branch on a batch
run_SAM3DBody_forward_pose_branch: run the forward pass for the crop-image pose branch to get body and hand predictions
run_SAM3DBody_keypoint_prompt: run keypoint prompting to refine body pose estimation using wrist and elbow locations from hand decoder
run_SAM3DBody_forward_decoder: run the decoder forward pass with image embeddings, keypoint prompts, and condition info to get pose output
